form.label: VAREK: the Warden's decisions
form.description: Refusals by policy line, agent and run; what dry runs let through; failed audits. The events are OCSF 1.9.0, sent by varek export --format splunk (macro varek_events).

search.query: `varek_events` varek_run="$run$" host="$host$" varek_event=audit varek_audit_passed=false | stats count

chart.title: Refusals over time, by what decided them

search.query: `varek_events` varek_run="$run$" host="$host$" `varek_refused` | timechart count by varek_decided_by limit=8 useother=true

table.title: Refusals by policy line (or the rule, for a default deny)

search.query: `varek_events` varek_run="$run$" host="$host$" `varek_refused` | stats count AS refused dc(varek_run) AS runs values(varek_target) AS targets latest(_time) AS last BY varek_decided_by | sort - refused | eval last=strftime(last, "%F %T %Z") | rename varek_decided_by AS "decided by"

`varek_events` varek_run="$run$" host="$host$" `varek_refused` | eval agent=coalesce(varek_agent, "(the agent)") | stats count AS refused dc(varek_decided_by) AS "policy lines" BY agent | sort - refused

`varek_events` varek_run="$run$" host="$host$" | stats count(eval(varek_decision="DENY" AND coalesce(varek_mode, "")!="dry_run")) AS refused count(eval(isnotnull(varek_decision))) AS decisions count(eval(varek_mode="dry_run")) AS "dry run, let through" values(eval(if(varek_event="audit", if(varek_audit_passed="true", "passed", "FAILED"), null()))) AS audit earliest(_time) AS start latest(_time) AS end values(varek_policy_name) AS policy BY varek_run host | rename varek_run AS run | eval start=strftime(start, "%F %T %Z"), end=strftime(end, "%F %T %Z") | sort - end

`varek_events` varek_run="$run$" host="$host$" `varek_refused` | eval when=strftime(_time, "%F %T.%3N %Z") | table when host varek_agent class_name activity_name varek_target varek_verdict varek_decided_by varek_run varek_report_id | rename varek_agent AS agent class_name AS class activity_name AS activity varek_target AS target varek_verdict AS verdict varek_decided_by AS "decided by" varek_run AS run varek_report_id AS record

table.title: Dry runs: what the policy refuses, let through and recorded

search.query: `varek_events` varek_run="$run$" host="$host$" varek_mode=dry_run | stats count BY varek_decided_by varek_target | sort - count | rename varek_decided_by AS "decided by" varek_target AS target

`varek_events` varek_run="$run$" host="$host$" varek_event=audit varek_audit_passed=false | eval when=strftime(_time, "%F %T %Z") | table when host varek_run unmapped.varek.audit.mode unmapped.varek.audit.problems{} | rename varek_run AS run unmapped.varek.audit.mode AS mode unmapped.varek.audit.problems{} AS problems
